name: MonarchPeriodSelector
title: PeriodSelector
wrapsNative: Picker with .pickerStyle(.segmented), inside ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) with a Picker with .pickerStyle(.menu) fallback; MonarchDateRangePicker (two DatePicker rows) for the custom period; Date.IntervalFormatStyle for the resolved dates
summary: Picks the period a dashboard or report covers, from presets such as today, the last 7 or 30 days and this quarter, or a custom date range, and gives the app the resolved first and last day.
whenToUse: When a dashboard, report or chart can be scoped to a period and every app should name and compute periods the same way.
whenNotToUse: For a single date, use DatePicker. For any range without presets, use MonarchDateRangePicker directly.
api: init(_ label: String? = nil, selection: Binding<MonarchPeriod>, presets: [MonarchPeriodPreset] = [.today, .last7Days, .last30Days, .thisQuarter, .custom], variant: MonarchPeriodSelectorVariant = .segmented, showsRange: Bool = false, today: Date = Date(), minimumDate: Date? = nil, maximumDate: Date? = nil, maximumDays: Int? = nil, labels: MonarchPeriodSelectorLabels = MonarchPeriodSelectorLabels())

struct MonarchPeriod { init(_ preset: MonarchPeriodPreset, range: ClosedRange<Date>? = nil); var preset: MonarchPeriodPreset; var range: ClosedRange<Date>?; func resolved(today: Date, calendar: Calendar) -> ClosedRange<Date>? }

enum MonarchPeriodPreset: String { case today, yesterday, last7Days = "7d", last14Days = "14d", last30Days = "30d", last90Days = "90d", last180Days = "180d", last365Days = "365d", thisWeek = "this-week", thisMonth = "this-month", lastMonth = "last-month", thisQuarter = "this-quarter", lastQuarter = "last-quarter", thisYear = "this-year", custom }
MonarchPeriodSelectorLabels.init(presets: [MonarchPeriodPreset: String] = [:], customRange: String? = nil, dateRange: MonarchDateRangePickerLabels = MonarchDateRangePickerLabels())

options.name: label
options.description: The name of the control, read by VoiceOver. Built in: "Period".

options.name: selection
options.description: The chosen preset, and the days of a custom period.

options.name: variant
options.description: Segments, which become a menu when they do not fit or at the accessibility text sizes, or a pop-up menu.

options.name: showsRange
options.description: Shows the resolved dates under the control, such as "Oct 9 – Nov 7, 2026".

options.name: today
options.description: The day presets count from. Pass the workspace's day to match the server.

options.name: minimumDate
options.description: The earliest day a custom period can start.

options.name: maximumDate
options.description: The latest day a custom period can end. By default today.

options.name: maximumDays
options.description: The longest custom period in days, such as 366 for reports.

options.name: labels
options.description: Preset names merged per preset, the custom range label, and the date range picker's strings.

states.name: preset
states.description: The chosen preset is the selected segment or the menu's title; with showsRange its first and last day are written under it.

states.name: custom
states.description: A MonarchDateRangePicker labelled "Custom period" appears under the presets, starting from the dates shown before; its end is limited to maximumDate (today by default) and its length to maximumDays.

states.name: custom without dates
states.description: With no range yet, the picker shows its Choose dates button and resolved(today:calendar:) returns nil.

states.name: menu
states.description: The menu variant, and the segmented variant when its segments do not fit or at the accessibility text sizes, is a system pop-up button showing the chosen preset.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With .disabled(true) the picker and the date pickers are the system's disabled controls.

appearance: The system segmented control or pop-up button in the app's tint, the custom range in MonarchDateRangePicker's look, and the resolved dates in the caption style with the muted text role. The controls follow the system's light, dark and increased-contrast appearance.
platformNotes: iOS uses the system segmented control and pop-up menu instead of the web's SegmentedControl and Select; segments that do not fit become the menu instead of scrolling sideways as on the web, because a segmented control does not scroll and does not grow with Dynamic Type. The web's size (sm, md) is not offered: the system controls have one height that follows Dynamic Type. The value is a MonarchPeriod holding Date values, and resolved(today:calendar:) plays the web's resolvePeriod: rolling presets end today and count today, this week starts on the calendar's first weekday (the web's weekStartsOn), and dates are the first moment of each day in the calendar's time zone. The raw values of MonarchPeriodPreset are the web's preset names. The binding replaces the web's onValueChange; read the resolved dates in onChange. Android has no PeriodSelector yet.
accessibility: The picker is named by label ("Period") and keeps the system's segmented control or pop-up button role, with the chosen preset as its value.
The custom range is a MonarchDateRangePicker named "Custom period": its pickers read "Custom period, Start" and "Custom period, End".
The resolved dates are static text written in the locale.
Segments become a menu at the accessibility text sizes, so every preset name stays readable.
edgeCases: Choosing the preset already chosen changes nothing.
Choosing Custom starts from the dates already shown, so nothing jumps; the custom dates are kept while another preset is chosen and come back with Custom.
A custom range is never cleared from the selector; it has no clear button.
Last month and last quarter are whole months, including February in a leap year and the last quarter of the previous year in January.
Presets resolve against today and the environment's calendar; pass both to match a server in another time zone.

examples.title: Report periods with a custom range
examples.webExample: Report periods with a custom range
examples.code:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
    MonarchPeriodSelector(
        selection: $period,
        presets: ["7d", "30d", "90d", "this-month", "last-month", "custom"]
            .compactMap { MonarchPeriodPreset(rawValue: $0) },
        today: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_794_009_600),
        maximumDays: 366
    )
    Text(verbatim: query)
        .monarchTextStyle(.caption)
}

examples.title: Report presets in a menu, with a custom range of at most 366 days
examples.code:
MonarchPeriodSelector(
    "Report period",
    selection: $period,
    presets: [.last7Days, .last30Days, .last90Days, .thisMonth, .lastMonth, .custom],
    variant: .menu,
    maximumDays: 366
)
